verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents a REST API v2.0, a FIX API, a WebSocket API, OAuth client-credentials auth, a sandbox, and llms.txt files for AI tools, but none of it mentions an official SDK or client library in any language. Raw APIs and AI-indexable docs are developer building blocks or adjacent features, not official SDKs. An API platform could plausibly ship SDKs, so the axis applies and the lack of evidence yields none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
